changes: Created the new stable massing library because no existing Sigma Chi asset matched FID 828.
Built the closed wall shell from the complete six-vertex official GIS ring in campus coordinates.
Kept the L-shaped notch open and composed the roof from two primary gable wings plus three photo-informed cross-gable bays that interrupt the long roof plane.
Added a gabled entry porch with timber knee braces, an extruded stone arch surround, irregular window groupings, a wider mullioned opening, dormers, and ridge chimneys based on chapter photos.
Kept eaves, roof heights, gable sizes, and opening locations as estimates from perspective photos; GIS floor fields remain unverified.
Stored the expected named scene and exported collection; audit cameras/lights remain outside the exported collection.
geometry.wall_plan_source_match: exact transformed source ring vertex sequence

height_m.uncertainty: No current elevation drawing or point-cloud sample. Eaves, roof ridges, and chimney stacks are proportion estimates from perspective historic photos. GIS Extrution=12 is an undocumented service attribute and is not treated as a measured height.

floor_count.uncertainty: GIS NUM_LEVELS and CountOfFLO both say 1; facade course spacing in the illustrative asset is not evidence of floor count.

roof_and_facade.uncertainty: Only historic 1960-62 and 2006-07 chapter photos were available; no measured current elevations or construction drawings. Two main roof wings, three cross-gable bays, window groupings, and exact detail positions are source-informed estimates; the 2006 image is during construction.
